title: Cogito, Ergo Ludo: An Agent that Learns to Play by Reasoning and Planning
problem: Learning complex environments through reinforcement learning requires extensive experience and hides acquired knowledge in neural weights.
assumption_broken: An agent can learn explicit rules and strategies in language instead of encoding all learning in model weights.
operational_signature: Interact → inspect trajectories → infer rules → summarize strategies → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Episode-level reflection concurrently refines an explicit dynamics model and an actionable strategic playbook.

title: Transferring Jailbreak Attacks from Public to Private LLMs via Local Prompt Optimization
problem: Optimization-based jailbreaks are difficult to apply to private models accessible only through query APIs.
assumption_broken: Gradient-informed attack optimization can be performed locally without accessing private model parameters.
operational_signature: Query → align distributions → optimize locally → transfer
load_bearing_mechanism: An auxiliary adversarial suffix aligns public and private output distributions to support transferable local prompt optimization.

title: Online-Optimized RAG for Tool Use and Function Calling
problem: Misaligned query and tool-description embeddings cause retrieval errors and downstream task failures.
assumption_broken: Retrieval embeddings can adapt during deployment rather than remaining fixed after initialization.
operational_signature: Retrieve → execute → observe feedback → update embeddings → retrieve
load_bearing_mechanism: Lightweight online gradient updates adapt retrieval embeddings using minimal live task-success feedback without changing the underlying LLM.

title: Reinforcing Query-Level Meta-Agents
problem: Designing a separate effective multi-agent system for each query requires automated reasoning about system structure.
assumption_broken: The system-designing meta-agent can itself be trained using execution feedback rather than relying on a fixed prompting procedure.
operational_signature: Distill reasoning → generate a system → execute → score → reinforce the generator
load_bearing_mechanism: Distillation followed by reinforcement learning trains a query-level system generator with rewards for performance, complexity, and efficiency.

improver_modified.how: FlowReasoner, the meta-agent that generates multi-agent systems, is improved through reasoning distillation and reinforcement learning.

title: SuperCoder: Assembly Program Superoptimization with Large Language Models
problem: Compiler-optimized assembly programs still leave performance gains that existing small superoptimization datasets cannot adequately test.
assumption_broken: LLMs can optimize realistic assembly programs beyond compiler heuristics while learning to preserve behavior.
operational_signature: Generate rewrites → test correctness → measure speed → reinforce → refine
load_bearing_mechanism: Reinforcement learning jointly rewards assembly correctness and speedup, with best-of-N sampling and iterative refinement providing further gains.

improver_modified.how: The assembly-rewriting model is fine-tuned with reinforcement learning on correctness and speedup rewards.

title: SPOGW: a Score-based Preference Optimization method via Group-Wise comparison for workflows
problem: Discrete workflow optimization and pairwise preference comparisons restrict representation, adaptability, and scalability.
assumption_broken: Workflow optimization can use cardinal rewards and group-wise comparisons in continuous policy space instead of discrete pairwise search.
operational_signature: Generate groups → score → compare advantages → constrain updates → retrain
load_bearing_mechanism: Iterative Offline GRPO with advantage-masked KL restriction emphasizes advantageous response regions during score-based workflow optimization.

improver_modified.how: The workflow-generation policy is trained with iterative offline GRPO and advantage-masked KL restriction.

title: PREMISE: Scalable and Strategic Prompt Optimization for Efficient Mathematical Reasoning in Large Models
problem: Commercial reasoning models produce redundant reasoning tokens that inflate latency and cost.
assumption_broken: Reasoning efficiency can be optimized through prompts alone without modifying weights or adding inference queries.
operational_signature: Diagnose traces → critique redundancy → revise instructions → assess accuracy and length
load_bearing_mechanism: Natural-language gradients jointly optimize prompt brevity and answer validity using trace-level diagnostics.

title: Opponent Simulation as Inference-time Scaling for Self-improving Agent: Case Study of Repeated Negotiations
problem: Static self-play and offline training fail to exploit repeated interaction feedback about previously unknown opponents.
assumption_broken: Opponent beliefs and best responses can be updated at inference time without offline retraining.
operational_signature: Observe interactions → model average behavior → brainstorm candidates → simulate → choose
load_bearing_mechanism: An in-context opponent model imitates time-averaged behavior and scores strategically brainstormed best-of-N responses through simulation.

title: Unsupervised Prompt Learning with Few-shot Examples for Answering Objective Questions
problem: Unsupervised prompt learning mismatches inference when few-shot pseudo-supervised examples are selected only after prompt training.
assumption_broken: Prompts and pseudo-supervised in-context examples can be jointly refined without human supervision or parameter retraining.
operational_signature: Generate pseudo-labels → condition on examples → check consistency → form critiques → jointly refine
load_bearing_mechanism: Gradient-derived textual critiques jointly refine the prompt and pseudo-supervision under an answer-consistency objective that matches few-shot usage.

title: Prompt Optimization Across Multiple Agents for Representing Diverse Human Populations
problem: A single LLM agent produces overly homogeneous behavior and poorly represents diverse human populations.
assumption_broken: Population diversity can be represented by selecting a complementary set of demonstration-conditioned agents instead of one representative agent.
operational_signature: Condition candidates → measure representation → select a complementary set → assess new tasks
load_bearing_mechanism: Submodular optimization selects a representative set of agents from the combinatorial space of human-demonstration-conditioned prompts.

title: Self-Improving Model Steering
problem: Conventional model steering depends on externally annotated data and adapts poorly to changing contexts.
assumption_broken: Context-specific steering can improve through autonomously generated contrastive samples rather than external supervision.
operational_signature: Generate contrasts → rank prompts → refine samples → steer → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Iterative autonomous contrastive-sample refinement, combined with prompt ranking and contrast sampling, supplies adaptive steering supervision.

title: Prompt reinforcing for long-term planning of large language models
problem: LLM agents persist with incorrect early assumptions and fail to track user goals in multi-turn tasks.
assumption_broken: Long-term planning can improve through task-instruction rewriting without updating model parameters.
operational_signature: Interact → collect turn feedback → replay experiences → rewrite instructions → interact
load_bearing_mechanism: Reinforcement-learning-inspired prompt rewriting uses turn-by-turn feedback and experience replay to improve long-term planning.

title: Self-Prompt: Leveraging Gradient-Based Search for Optimizing Prompts in Code Generation
problem: Manual and LLM-generated code prompts are costly or inconsistent and limited by the constructing model.
assumption_broken: Prompt construction can be treated as a task-data-driven search problem rather than relying on unconstrained LLM prompt generation.
operational_signature: Use task data → search instructions → generate outputs → evaluate → refine
load_bearing_mechanism: Task-specific data drives iterative prompt search to stabilize and progressively improve code generation.

title: Learning on the Job: An Experience-Driven Self-Evolving Agent for Long-Horizon Tasks
problem: Test-time-static agents cannot accumulate and reuse experience to improve long-horizon productivity tasks.
assumption_broken: Agents can learn on the job through structured memory without changing pretrained parameters.
operational_signature: Execute a subtask → reflect on trajectory → structure experience → store → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: A hierarchical memory module integrates reflected subtask experiences and reuses them for subsequent planning and execution.

title: KVCache-Centric Memory for LLM Agents
problem: Plaintext agent memory has unstable retrieval and disrupts prefix caching in long-horizon workflows.
assumption_broken: Reusable agent memory can remain in native KV-cache form instead of being retrieved and re-encoded as plaintext.
operational_signature: Encode interactions → store latent blocks → score relevance → retrieve → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Compressed-key multi-token attention retrieval and decoupled position encoding enable coherent reuse of conversational KV-cache blocks.

title: ExpeSQL: An Experience-Guided Decompositional Search Framework for Text-to-SQL
problem: Enterprise Text-to-SQL faces evolving schemas, domain shift, privacy constraints, and tight latency and token budgets.
assumption_broken: SQL generation can continually improve by replaying structured error remedies without parameter updates.
operational_signature: Decompose → generate candidates → execute and vote → diagnose errors → store remedies → replay
load_bearing_mechanism: Diagnostic backtracking distills errors into persistent structured remedies that guide future decompositional SQL search.

title: Agent²: An Agent-Generates-Agent Framework for Reinforcement Learning Automation
problem: RL agent development requires substantial expertise and repeated manual effort with high failure rates.
assumption_broken: A generator agent can translate task descriptions and environment code into executable RL agents without human design.
operational_signature: Analyze requirements → model the task → generate an agent → train and execute → analyze feedback → refine
load_bearing_mechanism: A dual-agent loop separates MDP modeling from algorithmic optimization and uses adaptive training management and feedback analysis for refinement.

title: Towards Robust Agentic Systems through Generative Flow Exploration of Primitives
problem: Automated multi-agent design optimizes task performance while leaving external adversaries and internal failures insufficiently addressed.
assumption_broken: Robustness signals can participate directly in workflow generation rather than being checked only after design.
operational_signature: Compose primitives → execute → extract safety feedback → propagate rewards → refine behaviors
load_bearing_mechanism: Flow-based sequence optimization over symbolic primitives combines numeric exploration rewards with trace-derived textual safety feedback.

improver_modified.how: Flow-based optimization updates the sequence-generation policy that proposes agentic systems.

title: EvoAgent: Self-evolving Agent with Continual World Model for Long-Horizon Tasks
problem: Embodied long-horizon agents depend on human-curated experiences and forget world knowledge when encountering new tasks.
assumption_broken: An agent can autonomously select experiences and continually update its world model instead of relying on a fixed model or human curriculum.
operational_signature: Plan → act → self-verify → collect experiences → select curriculum → update the world model
load_bearing_mechanism: A two-stage curriculum selects self-collected multimodal experiences for task-adaptive continual world-model updates within a closed interaction loop.

title: Alignment Tipping Process: How Self-Evolution Pushes LLM Agents Off the Rails
problem: Self-evolving agents can lose training-time alignment through deployment feedback and social diffusion.
assumption_broken: Alignment is a dynamic, feedback-sensitive property rather than a stable consequence of alignment training.
operational_signature: Interact → reward deviations → reinforce strategies → imitate successes → track alignment drift
load_bearing_mechanism: Controllable testbeds isolate high-reward self-interested exploration and imitative diffusion as routes to alignment tipping.
limitations_evident: Current reinforcement-learning-based alignment defenses remain fragile under the studied self-evolution dynamics.

title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Planning with Adaptive Skill Synthesis
problem: Cooperative multi-agent learning lacks sample efficiency, interpretability, and generalization under partial observability.
assumption_broken: Decentralized coordination can use visual observations and dynamically synthesized code skills rather than text-only planning or fixed policies.
operational_signature: Observe → communicate entities → synthesize strategies → execute → refine skills
load_bearing_mechanism: Expert-bootstrapped interpretable code skills are dynamically refined while structured multi-hop entity communication coordinates partial observations.

title: SPLiT: Popularity-Bias-Aware Online Prompt Optimization for LLM-based Recommendation
problem: Popularity-biased and stochastic preference summaries distort LLM recommendations away from users actual interests.
assumption_broken: Preference summaries should be selected online for both fidelity and popularity amplification rather than treated as neutral summaries.
operational_signature: Generate summaries → estimate fidelity → penalize popularity lift → select → update online
load_bearing_mechanism: Contextual Bayesian optimization selects preference summaries under a Semantic Popularity Lift penalty that discourages popularity amplification.

title: CATArena:  Evaluation of LLM Agents Through Iterative Tournament Competitions
problem: Fixed-scenario agent benchmarks saturate and inadequately measure self-improvement and peer-learning.
assumption_broken: Agent evaluation can measure learning through repeated open-ended competition instead of relying only on fixed end-to-end scores.
operational_signature: Compete → receive feedback → learn from peers → revise strategies → compete again
load_bearing_mechanism: Iterative tournament competitions with open-ended scoring expose agents ability to improve strategy code through feedback and peer-learning.

title: SIDiffAgent: Self-Improving Diffusion Agent
problem: Diffusion generation is sensitive to prompt phrasing, semantic ambiguity, and visual artifacts while requiring careful manual prompt engineering.
assumption_broken: Image-generation pipelines can improve through experience-conditioned agentic correction without additional model training.
operational_signature: Retrieve experience → refine instructions → generate → detect defects → correct → store experience
load_bearing_mechanism: A database of past experiences injects prompt guidance throughout an agentic image-generation and artifact-correction pipeline.

title: A-MemGuard: A Proactive Defense Framework for LLM-Based Agent Memory
problem: Context-triggered memory poisoning can evade isolated audits and create self-reinforcing error precedents.
assumption_broken: Agent memory can actively validate and correct itself rather than depend on static entry-level filtering.
operational_signature: Retrieve related memories → compare reasoning → detect anomalies → distill lessons → consult before acting
load_bearing_mechanism: Consensus validation across memory-derived reasoning paths combines with a separate failure-lesson memory to interrupt recurring poisoned-memory errors.

title: Metacognitive Reuse: Turning Recurring LLM Reasoning Into Concise Behaviors
problem: LLMs repeatedly re-derive intermediate reasoning steps, wasting tokens and context capacity.
assumption_broken: Reusable procedural behaviors can replace repeated derivations and improve future reasoning without requiring parameter updates.
operational_signature: Inspect prior traces → extract recurring procedures → name behaviors → store → condition future reasoning
load_bearing_mechanism: Metacognitive analysis compresses recurring reasoning into named instructions stored in a behavior handbook for inference reuse or supervised distillation.

improver_modified.how: The abstract describes conditioning or fine-tuning the reasoning model, not modifying the metacognitive behavior-extraction procedure.

title: Reasoning-Intensive Regression
problem: Limited-data numerical scoring from text demands contextual reasoning that frozen prompting and encoder fine-tuning often fail to provide.
assumption_broken: Reasoning-intensive regression can combine adaptive prompts with neural ensembles instead of choosing between prompting and encoder learning.
operational_signature: Collect task batches → reflect on errors → optimize prompts → learn an ensemble → predict scores
load_bearing_mechanism: MENTAT combines batch-reflective prompt optimization with neural ensemble learning for reasoning-intensive numerical prediction.
limitations_evident: Substantial performance headroom remains on the proposed reasoning-intensive regression tasks.

title: EvoEngineer: Mastering Automated CUDA Kernel Code Evolution with Large Language Models
problem: CUDA kernel optimization lacks comparable formulations and general-purpose code evolution fails strict correctness requirements.
assumption_broken: Kernel code evolution should jointly account for explicit correctness constraints and speed rather than reuse generic optimization strategies unchanged.
operational_signature: Specify constraints → evolve code → validate → measure speed → adapt optimization
load_bearing_mechanism: A systematic code-evolution framework defines objectives, constraints, and metrics to guide optimization strategies toward both correctness and performance.
